item.title: 2 or 3 quits won't affect NCP: Akhtar
item.description: National Citizen Party (NCP) Member Secretary Akhtar Hossain on Sunday said that two or three resignations would not have any impact on the party's organisational strength.Speaking to reporters after securing bail from two separate courts of Dhaka Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrates Awlad Hossain Mohammad Junaid and Jashita Islam, Akhtar downplayed the resignations, describing them as part of a natural political process."Many have joined our party and many have left. item.title: I won't resign: Samantha
item.description: National Citizen Party (NCP) has deviated from its original political objective by joining an alliance led by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, but there is no justification for her to resign from the party, said NCP Senior Joint Convener Samantha Sharmin on Sunday evening.In a Facebook post, Samantha said she learned from Jamaat's press conference that the NCP had formally joined the Jamaat-led alliance of like-minded parties. item.title: Injured England quick Atkinson out of 5th Ashes Test

item.title: Submission of nomination paper deadline ends at 5PM, 3,114 collected
item.description: The deadline for the submission of nomination papers in the upcoming national election sets to expire at 5PM on Monday (December 29).After the deadline, all nomination papers received by Assistant Returning Officers (AROs) must be forwarded immediately to the respective ROs along with the required security deposits.According to the EC schedule, scrutiny of nomination papers will be conducted from December 30 to January 4. Candidates may file appeals against RO decisions from January 5 to January
